name: resize192_head640_head_ce_fp32
selection_reason: Balanced FP32 structural-compression winner: 640 final feature channels and classifier-only recovery on all 27000 images, 7.703 MiB versus 8.506 MiB original baseline, 99.1481% training-set accuracy and 97.40% worst-class recall. Matched three-repetition four-thread CPU measurements show 1.9791 ms and 0.040847 estimated J per image, 21.8% lower latency and 22.8% lower estimated energy than original224. Runtime is effectively similar to unpruned recovered192 within variability; actual size falls 9.5% and accuracy gains eleven correct images. The smaller block-removal model loses more accuracy and class balance. Weights, checkpoint storage and CPU compute remain FP32; older winners are preserved.
